findings.detail: Git operations are local subprocess calls, no network timeout needed
findings.recommendation: Consider process-level timeout for very large repos

findings.detail: No timeout on git subprocess calls; rev-list --count and log can be slow on large repos
findings.recommendation: Add context timeout for git operations on this endpoint

endpoint_resiliency.cascading_failure_risk: Slow git operations could tie up request threads

findings.detail: Streaming diff output has no size or time limit; large diffs could hold connections open
findings.recommendation: Add response size limit or streaming timeout

endpoint_resiliency.cascading_failure_risk: Large diffs could consume memory and hold connections
